title: Gen AI Revolution in CTV Advertising | NETINT

facts.fact: CTV ad spending is projected by the NETINT blog to surpass $40 billion annually by 2025 and reach 90% of US households.
facts.quote: CTV ad spending projected to surpass $40 billion annually by 2025 and reach 90% of US households

facts.fact: The NETINT blog states that traditional CTV campaigns typically demand production budgets exceeding $50,000.
facts.quote: Traditional campaigns typically demand production budgets exceeding $50,000 and weeks of meticulous planning

facts.fact: The NETINT blog says traditional ad platforms involve as many as 21 or more complex campaign setup steps, while Streamr's Gen AI system streamlines this to ten steps.
facts.quote: streamlines this to just ten intuitive steps

facts.fact: Streamr, per the NETINT blog, claims its Gen AI system delivers a 52% reduction in campaign setup complexity.
The NETINT blog reports that one Streamr client reached 143% more qualified leads after switching to AI-automated targeting.
facts.quote: One Streamr client reported reaching 143% more qualified leads

facts.fact: The NETINT blog reports that the same Streamr client reduced setup time by 85% after switching to AI-automated targeting.
The NETINT blog says early adopters of Gen AI CTV advertising report average engagement rates increasing by 312%.
facts.quote: Early adopters report seeing average engagement rates increase by 312%

facts.fact: The NETINT blog says early adopters of Gen AI CTV advertising report cost-per-acquisition decreasing by 47%.
The NETINT blog reports, without naming a source, that major networks saw 40% higher fill rates.
facts.quote: major networks reporting 40% higher fill rates

facts.fact: The NETINT blog reports that viewers experienced 65% fewer repeated ads.
